2440-3517-7690--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
The other Hero has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2440-3517-7690--165.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature that shares a creature type with the creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

424-868-8219.description:
Cast Stream of Consciousness by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Stream of Consciousness.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Stream of Consciousness, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting a player
Resolve Stream of Consciousness, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1169-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2577-4247-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4247-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-3277-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3277-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1170-1636-7546-7875.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Maestro's Gift using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-7546-7875.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Inspired Skypainter.
When Inspired Skypainter enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6137.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6137.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Barrowin of Clan Undurr to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Barrowin of Clan Undurr enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Barrowin of Clan Undurr trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

3532-5078-6595-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

573-1479-7705.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1169-1368-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1169-1368-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-5570-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

147-2034-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

1308-2034-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

872-3259-5621--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
872-3259-5621--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-628-7211.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Brambleback Brute enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1734-2438-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-2438-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

104-4050-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

539-5226-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-4875-5231-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2781-4875-5231-6243.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {R}.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

1126-3047-4871.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Feign Death.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

390-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Enough additional mana and/or artifacts on the battlefield to make up for Emry's command tax (if applicable).
390-1329-3169-4050.description:
Cast Emry by paying {U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
When Emry enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Genesis Chamber, and the copy of Genesis Chamber.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve Emry's ability, milling four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Send Emry from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times.

2092-2477-4050.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
2092-2477-4050.description:
Activate Prava of the Steel Legion by paying {W} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2581-2882-3499.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Dauthi Voidwalker.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
An opponent has a creature card in exile with a void counter on it.
2581-2882-3499.description:
Activate a Dauthi Voidwalker that does not have Infinite Reflection attached by tapping and sacrificing it.
If the creature was owned by an opponent, it is exiled with a void counter instead of being put into its owner's graveyard.
Resolve the Dauthi Voidwalker ability, causing you to cast a creature card from an opponent's exile without paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield as a copy of Dauthi Voidwalker due to Infinite Reflection.
Repeat.

313-2034-3503-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional Spirits.
313-2034-3503-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spectral Arcanist, adding {C}{C}.
Spectral Arcanist dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance by paying {2}{B}, returning Spectral Arcanist from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spectral Arcanist, adding {C}{C}.
Spectral Arcanist dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Corpse Dance from your graveyard with buyback by paying {2}.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Spectral Arcanist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, allowing you to cast any instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
